title: BENCHMARKING LLM COMPETENCE ON LOGICAL INFERENCE OVER PROBABILITY OPERATORS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the signed accuracy gap between questions where the correct answer is 'Yes' versus 'No' to identify systematic preferences for affirmative or negative responses independent of logical validity.

Varying question formats, negation strategies (e.g., prefix negation vs. the word 'not'), and scenario activity descriptions to measure fluctuations in model accuracy on semantically identical logical inferences.

Substituting names drawn from seven different nationality groups (Indian, Russian, Japanese, African, German, French, American) in the prompts and comparing inference accuracy and refusal rates against an abstract letter variable baseline.
Counterfactual name substitution using common male and female names in the prompts and measuring the accuracy gap between the two genders relative to a baseline control.
